caption: The drawing depicts an hourglass-shaped clock with a wooden frame, finished in a brown tone with distinct wood grain visible. The upper portion of the clock houses a round, white clock face with black Roman numerals and black clock hands, topped by a semicircular arch that features a floral motif with red and green accents on a pale blue background. The lower portion of the clock case displays a hand-painted scene of a white house with a columned front porch, green shrubbery, a tree, and a picket fence, set against a blue sky with pinkish clouds. The clock sits on a rectangular wooden base with steps. The background of the drawing is plain, with a simple rectangular border framing the clock on an off-white paper. The artist’s signature, "L. Phillips," appears in the bottom right corner.
title: Clock
